notes: Candidate discovery is automatic, but source ranking and automatic promotion stay disabled until the frozen historical outcome set and feedback-loop calibration are approved.
Zero is a real measured value only after calibration; missing source-quality features remain evidence-insufficient and must not be presented as a bad score.
Promotion is append-only audited and limited to floor(five percent of the start-of-day active population); the initial active cohort must be reviewed manually.
